findings.detail: Both PIL._imaging and PIL._imagingft are absent from the 11 explicit held-directory policies. The loader defaults them to exact-file-fd-v1, passes /proc/self/fd/<leafFD> to ExtensionFileLoader and spec.origin, while both contain DT_RPATH $ORIGIN/../pillow.libs. The relative sibling library directory is present under staged root0, but there is no corresponding /proc/self/pillow.libs namespace path. The existing held-directory mechanism returns /proc/self/fd/<parentFD>/<leaf> and is specifically authored for relative origins.

The existing directory policy checks target edges before load, observes persistent raw device/inode map identity after load, then rechecks. It does not prevent a directory-edge race from executing changed native code before refusal and cannot qualify transient mappings, anonymous/JIT images or native initializers.

finite_elf_scope.method: BFS from all 23 registered extension rows through pinned DT_NEEDED; resolve own declared RPATH/RUNPATH after content-origin expansion or explicit namespace default-lib aliases. Fresh readelf --wide --dynamic on every selected ELF, comparing NEEDED/RPATH/RUNPATH/SONAME to native metadata05. No basename-only/SO-NAME-only global resolution and no ldd. This is declared-route coverage, not a complete glibc loader emulator, import-path proof, or native execution.
